setup_notes.heading: Installation
setup_notes.content:
Clone the repository and install the skill into the Python environment that runs the OVOS skills:

git clone https://github.com/iBreve/ovos-skill-workwell-orchestrator
cd ovos-skill-workwell-orchestrator
pip install .

In a containerised OVOS setup, install the package in the image that runs the skills. The skill container has to use the same OVOS configuration and message bus as the other OVOS services.
